entries.alt: Four fictional adult women stand affectionately at a Bratislava Castle terrace above the Danube, wearing sharply shortened blue, silver, navy and white RAZE star outfits with complete classic pumps.
Four fictional adult women share a warm full-body pose before intact Spis Castle, wearing short blue, white, silver and green RAZE looks, rainbow over-the-knee stockings and complete classic pumps.

Four fictional adult women link hands beside Strbske Pleso beneath the High Tatras, wearing short split-star fashion, red and cobalt over-the-knee stockings on the two right women, and complete pumps.

Four fictional adult women pose together before Orava Castle and its river valley in short blue, silver, cream, red and green fashion with rainbow knee-high hosiery and four tall lettered RAZE star boots.
